prompt: Which 5 customers sent the highest total wire transfer amount in 2025? Give each customer's business id and their total.
sql:
SELECT d.business_id,
       SUM(f.original_amount) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON f.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer d ON f.customer_key = d.customer_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY d.business_id
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

prompt: How many distinct customers made both a wire transfer and an ATM transaction in 2025?
sql:
WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fwt.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
), atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fta.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction fta
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fta.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM wire_customers wc
JOIN atm_customers ac ON wc.customer_key = ac.customer_key;

prompt: How many loans were more than 90 days past due on 31 August 2025?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily fld
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fld.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_date = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND fld.days_past_due > 90;

prompt: Which 3 merchant category codes had the highest total card authorization amount in 2025? Give the merchant category code and the total.
sql:
SELECT
    m.merchant_category_code,
    SUM(f.original_amount) AS total_authorized_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant m
  ON f.merchant_key = m.merchant_key
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.authorized_at) = 2025
GROUP BY m.merchant_category_code
ORDER BY total_authorized_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

prompt: What percentage of card authorizations in 2025 had payment status code DECLINED? Answer as a percentage between 0 and 100.
sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
  , 2) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

prompt: How many escalated complaints were recorded in 2025 per complaint category name? One row per category.
sql:
SELECT
    dc.display_name AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dc ON fc.complaint_category_key = dc.complaint_category_key
WHERE
    dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
    AND fc.is_escalated = TRUE
GROUP BY
    dc.display_name
ORDER BY
    escalated_complaint_count DESC;

prompt: How many AML alerts with alert severity code HIGH were raised in 2025 per jurisdiction name? One row per jurisdiction.
sql:
SELECT j.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert a
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON a.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j ON a.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND a.alert_severity_code = 'HIGH'
GROUP BY j.display_name
ORDER BY high_severity_alerts_2025 DESC;

prompt: How many account transactions were made through the Mobile App channel in 2024 and in 2025? One row per year.
sql:
SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS mobile_app_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
  ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE c.display_name = 'Mobile App'
  AND d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

prompt: What was the average account closing balance on 30 June 2025?
sql:
SELECT AVG(f.closing_balance_amount) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-06-30';

prompt: How many distinct customers in the SME segment made at least one cross-border wire transfer in 2025?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fw.customer_key) AS distinct_sme_crossborder_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fw
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fw.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c ON fw.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE c.customer_segment_code = 'SME'
  AND fw.is_cross_border = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025;
